Papa's Crustless Breakfast Quiche
By: Layne Diehl
Published: Sunday, January 9, 2011 - 6:52am

Ingredients




1 cup Bisquick
2 cups milk
3 eggs
1 pound bacon
1 pound cheese
1/2 teaspoon salt
fresh cracked black pepper

Preparation

1 Fry bacon and crumble. 2 Shred cheese. 3 In mixing bowl, combine Bisquick, milk, and eggs. 4 Add prepared bacon and shredded cheese. 5 Mix in salt. 6 Pour into deep 9x13 inch baking dish. 7 Crack pepper on top. 8 Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

About


An easy recipe to prepare largely in advance, throw the ingredients together in the morning and put in the oven while everyone is starting to stir.  By the time you've had your first cup of coffee, the quiche is ready.  This is a great Saturday breakfast to serve to friends and doesn't create a lot of mess.  This is an easy recipe to modify to your tastes, as well.  Use pepper jack cheese if you like a little kick.  Ham or sausage can replace bacon.  Veggies can be added or used as a substitute for meat if desired.
